value.rationale: This is a complete family of exact nonunit-stratified inverse maxima for a canonical binary principal chain ring. It resolves whether maximum irreducible products can include noninvertible terms: impossible at every odd depth n>=5, possible with exactly one valuation-one factor at every even depth n>=6, with all exceptional small depths determined. The distinction and exact r dependence are not deducible from the scalar Davenport constant and support inverse zero-sum investigations; the unit-group orbit classification is expressly left open.
